intro: Connect, learn and grow with the AIChE Student Chapter at GSTU. Explore chapter activities and apply to join our chemical engineering community.
benefits: Connect with students, faculty, alumni and industry professionals in chemical engineering.
Hear first about chapter workshops, plant visits, seminars and competitions.
Build leadership, teamwork and professional skills through chapter projects and outreach.
eligibility: Students of chemical engineering and related disciplines are welcome to contact the chapter. Please confirm the current eligibility criteria with the membership team before applying.
general: General membership details and fees will be published after confirmation by the chapter.
premium: Premium membership benefits, eligibility, and fees will be published after confirmation by the chapter.
renewal: Existing members: contact the chapter with your name, membership ID, and membership year to confirm renewal requirements. Renewal fees and deadlines have not yet been published.
